operator: usecase Chevrotain lexer uses longest operator and delimiter precedence
keyword: usecase Chevrotain lexer keeps exact keywords out of longer identifiers and matches semantic words case-insensitively
newline: usecase Chevrotain lexer emits one token per physical newline for carriage return and line feed
jsonLocation: usecase Chevrotain lexer balances nested JSON while ignoring escaped quotes and braces in strings
unclosedMarkdown: usecase Chevrotain lexer consumes unclosed Markdown and stereotypes once instead of rescanning every suffix
decimal: usecase Chevrotain lexer lexes digit-leading ids as identifiers while decimals stay numbers

scope.productionUse: Grammar diagnostics tokenize the actual input; valid grammar remains the existing parser.
